eventDetail.scope: The ICMT is an annual international conference on mechatronics technology with successful past editions held for more than 20 years. ICMT offers a forum to discuss state-of-the-art technologies and emerging application trends, and provides great opportunities for interactions between academic and industrial stakeholders in the areas of mechatronics, control, robotics, innovative systems, sensors, energy harvesting, AI, Renewable Energy and Smart Grid etc.
